notes: This narrow trace covers the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.3.1 service-invocation report rule that FOM-added parameters are not sent by the RTI. The public-API test adds one parameter directly to HLAreportServiceInvocation and checks one RTI-originated Send Interaction report. Other MOM interaction classes are outside scope.

requirements.statement: Parameters may be added to any MOM interaction class. Interactions of these classes that are sent by the RTI shall not contain the new parameters.
